Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as Fed holds rates; focus turns to earnings
Markets.summary: US stocks closed higher after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady. The market gains were driven by strong earnings from chipmakers like SK Hynix.

Markets.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh says US economy not running too hot from AI boom
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh stated on Wednesday that the U.S. economy is not overheating despite increased demand from the artificial intelligence boom. He noted that the ongoing wave of AI investment has created some economic pressures, but they remain manageable.

Markets.title: Wendy’s draws buyout bid as beef costs and burger rivalry weigh on business
Markets.summary: Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management offered $7.35 per share to take Wendy’s private, causing the company's stock to jump. The buyout bid follows challenges for the burger chain, including high beef costs, weaker consumer demand, store closures, and intense fast-food competition.

Markets.title: US Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady as stubborn inflation puts future rate hikes in focus
Markets.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged to evaluate inflation trends driven by rising energy prices and tariffs. Policymakers and traders are assessing how these ongoing inflationary pressures might impact future monetary policy.

Markets.title: World Bank sees commodity prices surging 23% in 2026 on Middle East war
Markets.summary: The World Bank projects a 23% surge in global commodity prices for 2026 due to Middle East conflict disruptions affecting energy, shipping, food, and metals. This escalation threatens to intensify inflation and worsen global food security risks.

Markets.title: Satin Creditcare Q2 profit surges over three-fold as asset quality improves
Markets.summary: Satin Creditcare Network reported a more than three-fold increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 176 crore for the second quarter. This growth was driven by portfolio expansion, reduced microfinance provisions, and an improved gross NPA ratio of 1.9%.

Geo-Political.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
Geo-Political.summary: A high-speed train crash in Spain involving a moving train and a stopped train killed at least 68 people. The transport minister stated the collision was caused by an inexplicable error.

Geo-Political.title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
Geo-Political.summary: Survivors of Wednesday's train crash in Toledo province expressed shock, panic, and anger. Passengers suffered injuries during the disaster on their rail journey in Spain.

Geo-Political.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
Geo-Political.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro landed in Miami and denied allegations that he was fleeing Brazil. He claimed to be a victim of a coup d'état and political persecution while repeating unsubstantiated claims of electoral fraud.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
Geo-Political.summary: With 85% of the ballots counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc is leading the Israeli election with 53 seats. This result falls short of the 61 seats needed to secure a majority in the 120-seat Knesset.

Geo-Political.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
Geo-Political.summary: With 85 percent of votes counted, Israel's election is heading toward a deadlock. The most probable outcome of this political impasse is holding new elections.

Geo-Political.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park
Geo-Political.summary: An eight-year-old girl was seriously injured in a wolf attack at a German wildlife park. The incident occurred while she was inside an animal enclosure accompanied by other children and a staff member.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: India is the only major emerging economy projected to reduce its public debt ratio between 2025 and 2031. According to RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, India's debt-to-GDP ratio will drop from 84.3% in fiscal year 2026 to 75.1% by fiscal year 2032.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 8% in August. This expansion was driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation despite a decline in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with an outlay of ₹7,395.55 crore for the 2026-31 period. The scheme aims to strengthen governance across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and benefit approximately 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September, missing the expected 7.3% rate due to moderation in manufacturing and a 6.2% contraction in mining. Despite this monthly slowdown, industrial production grew 6.8% during the first half of the fiscal year, improving from 4.4% a year earlier.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Will disrupt business during Diwali’: Delhi traders' body writes to Rahul Gandhi over November 1 Ramlila Maidan march
Data & Insights.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry asked Rahul Gandhi for a meeting regarding the opposition's planned November 1 Ramlila Maidan rally. The trade body warned the march would disrupt 20 nearby markets and cause up to ₹10,000 crore in business losses ahead of Diwali.

Data & Insights.title: Why China is defying global inflationary tide—and what it means for the world
Data & Insights.summary: China is experiencing low inflation despite the global energy crisis due to deep structural flaws and a housing slump. These domestic economic issues threaten to spill over and impact the global economy.

India.title: From King Edward III To Neha Bora, A 1361 Law Lives On In 'Peace Bonds': NDTV Explains
India.summary: Three activist leaders recently signed peace bonds under a 1361 English law, with two facing jail for an alleged breach. The controversial use of these historical bonds has sparked questions regarding their relevance and legal logic in modern India.

India.summary: A house was vandalised during a protest against a dam project in Arunachal Pradesh. Former minister Ninong Ering condemned the violence and damage to property while calling for peaceful dialogue.

India.title: 10 Lakh Target, Anti-SIR Push: Congress Strategy For November 1 Ramlila Maidan Rally
India.summary: Congress MP Nasir Hussain stated that the party aims to gather 10 lakh people for the November 1 Ramlila Maidan rally with support from the INDIA alliance. The event focuses on an anti-SIR push and collective mobilization efforts.

India.title: BJP Ahead But Akhilesh Yadav's Party Gains Ground In UP MLC Elections
India.summary: The BJP won six of the first ten declared seats in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections. Akhilesh Yadav's Samajwadi Party secured the remaining four seats ahead of the upcoming Assembly polls.

India.title: Akal Takht Jathedar Flags Punjab's Drug Menace At UK Parliament
India.summary: Akal Takht Jathedar Giani Kuldip Singh Gargajj addressed Punjab's severe youth drug addiction crisis at the UK Parliament. He emphasized the need for a comprehensive strategy combining strict supply reduction with effective rehabilitation programs.

India.title: India Closely Monitoring Tehran Talks Involving Pakistan, Says Centre
India.summary: India's central government is closely watching talks in Tehran that involve Pakistan. The reported discussions aim to de-escalate regional tensions and secure a ceasefire between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthi group.

General.summary: Chancellor Healey announced a £100 energy bill support payment and a bank tax in his first Budget to address the cost of living crisis. However, opposition parties criticized the measures as insufficiently bold given current global economic turmoil.
